author: Nintendo of America
description:
Did you know that you can play Tetris® 99 with a Nintendo Switch Online membership*? You can customize your game with a wide variety of visual themes, some inspired by games on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 and Nintendo Switch systems. Normally you need to redeem up to 30 in-game tickets, obtained by completing daily challenges, to receive a theme available through the Customize menu—but during this event you can get select themes for just 2 tickets each. And if you're playing Tetris 99 for the very first time, you'll earn 10 tickets right away—which means you can add up to five themes to your collection immediately.

The event will be: July 23 (Thurs.) at 6 p.m. PT to Aug. 16 (Sun.) at 11:59 p.m. PT

* Nintendo Switch Online membership (sold separately) and Nintendo Account required for online features. Membership auto-renews after initial term at the then-current price unless canceled. Not available in all countries. Internet access required for online features. Terms apply. nintendo.com/p
title: Tetris® 99 – Limited Time Event Trailer - Nintendo Switch

author: Nintendo of America
description:
The digital version of the Xenoblade Chronicles 2 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition game will be available on July 30. The physical version launches on October 1. Pre-orders are available now on Nintendo eShop: https://ninten.do/6002vAKxo

Join Rex and Pyra in their search for paradise, now enhanced for the Nintendo Switch 2 system! The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of this game features improved visuals, smoother and sharper cutscenes, new outfit designs for Pyra and Mythra, and more. Control up to six Blades directly in the new Merc Assault mode, and discover MOMO—a new rare Blade who can swap between light and dark forms.

Nintendo Switch 2 players who already have Xenoblade Chronicles 2 on Nintendo Switch can upgrade to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition by purchasing the upgrade pack.

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
